name: Pompompurin
source:
Pompompurin (ポムポムプリン), also known as Purin (プリン), is an inhabitant from the world of love and dreams who travels to Hinamizawa. He appears in Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Mei in a collaboration event with Sanrio.

[From 07th Expansion wikia]
